status: Historical research measurements retained. Typed immutable projection caches are now enabled in production builds; the latency and memory figures below describe the earlier Windows prototype, not the final merged implementation.

research_selection.reason: Sequence-version and queue topology/route reuse preserves full output. Extra station-helper caches show no meaningful admin speed benefit on this clone and retain more memory.

memory_caveat: Allocation traffic is cumulative requested bytes, not RAM. Rust peak growth excludes existing live allocations, native allocations and OS RSS. Context estimates exclude allocator overhead. Heap-instrumented wall times are never used for speed claims.
stability_caveat: The measured prototype retains both core and handler revision-chasing loops. Finite RAM-notification bursts complete, but continuous mutation delivery is not guaranteed until coherent bounded publication and handler cursors are implemented.
implementation_order: Typed immutable ProjectionContext and borrowed/indexed topology/WIP views
One bounded CPU projector with commit-coherent input capture and truthful completed-version publication
Dependency-scoped invalidation with safe unknown-event fallback
Admin active-apparatus bootstrap, independent admin delta scope, conditional HTTP fallback and initial recovery

publication.kind: Production projection optimization with an optional isolated reference benchmark
publication.cargo_feature: projection-research enables only the benchmark and per-service reference selector
publication.measurement_scope: Pre-publication local Windows clone investigation. Feature isolation and portable harness configuration were added afterward; these benchmarks were not rerun for the publication package.
publication.dataset: 391 maps, 1564 admin controls, 3190 progress batches loaded for those maps; one immutable local business-data clone.
publication.compilation_checks: cargo check --locked --lib; cargo check --locked --features projection-research --example admin_projection_research

environment.MINI_ERP_DATABASE_URL: Must point to the isolated clone at 127.0.0.1:5433/mini_rs_erp_new; never printed.
environment.ERP_RESEARCH_ENV_FILE: Optional local .env file; use it when running from a separate checkout.
environment.ERP_RESEARCH_THREADS: 1 or 4 in the measured experiments; default 4.
environment.ERP_RESEARCH_MODES: Optional modes 0 (pure reference) and 1 (production cache); baseline 0 is required. Default 0,1.
environment.ERP_RESEARCH_APPARATUS: One canonical apparatus ID or unique suffix; default bosma_7.
environment.ERP_RESEARCH_HEAP: Build-time allocation instrumentation; rebuild with this variable absent for latency measurements.
environment.ERP_RESEARCH_WRITE_SNAPSHOTS: Default disabled; 1 enables private full snapshot output.
environment.ERP_RESEARCH_OUTPUT_DIR: Optional snapshot directory; default data/diagnostics/admin-projection-research, ignored by Git.

publication.safety: Read-only PostgreSQL connections; no HTTP business mutations, deployments or database migrations. Existing revision retry loops are deliberately retained.
publication.future_shipping_work: Coherent bounded publication, handler cursors and admin delivery are separate changes; existing revision retry semantics are retained.

production_safety.context: Explicit ProjectionMap borrows one immutable map; no pointer identities, thread-local state or global collected summaries.
production_safety.retention: Each context is dropped after one read projection. At most 256 route classes with keys capped at 4096 bytes, and two adjacency entries per map node; excess, oversized and stale identities compute normally without being retained.
production_safety.identity: Route classes include every field read by input routing and actionability, including complete bindings and session ownership witnesses.
production_safety.write_paths: Write validation uses the pure reference implementation. Database/schema, HTTP contracts and mutation locks are unchanged.
production_safety.differential_validation: 6 graph variants and 1728 WIP variants compare cached/reference routes, topology and stage status. Admin/worker JSON, parallel readers, map edit invalidation and thread handoff/capacity are tested.
production_safety.ci_hygiene: Unchanged formatting debt is pinned by exact file SHA256 from main d52d332. Changed/new Rust must format; new production files have a 500-line cap and legacy files cannot exceed their pre-change formatted size.

synthetic_latency.build: Rust debug build on local macOS; memory stores, not a production/PostgreSQL latency claim

production_validation.database_integration: No isolated live PostgreSQL instance was available. Database integration is not certified by these results; no schema or SQL changes are included.
